content.text: This is really common at 5, and it usually fades when the walk back to his own room is made boring and predictable. Tonight, tell him calmly before bed: "If you come in, I'll walk you straight back to your bed." Then do exactly that every time, with a quick hug, few words and no lecture. The first few nights tend to be the hardest, and being the same every time matters more than anything else.
